text:
deploy-bot: Starting release rollout: release/2026-03-25. Sequence: api@2.7.0 -> runtime@4.3.1 (kernel-gc) -> console@2.0.0 -> router@3.2.1. Change window 22:30-00:30 UTC. Canary plan 5% -> 20% -> 100%.
maria: Quick note: runtime GC tweak may increase short-term CPU; recommend extended smoke (6m) and a pin on api for 45m.
dan: The kernel update changes GC from incremental->batched and introduces a new mem-threshold guard (mem_guard=0.85). There was a reg in internal perf tests under high-concurrency; suggest limiting canary QPS ramp.
kevin: I'll throttle router ramp to 5% increments every 3m. I can toggle flag runtime_header_swap at ramp start.
ops-bot: Reserving +6 GPUs us-central1 for 75m starting 22:25 UTC.
sasha: Release notes pushed to: https://internal/docs/releases/2026-03-25. Added rollback checklist and who-to-ping.
maria: Rollback triggers proposal:
- 5xx > 2.5% sustained for 8m
- OOM-related errors (alloc failures) any occurrence 2+ in 5m
- p99 latency > 2x baseline for 5m
Any objections?
kevin: Add: if router header swap causes >15% fallback to stable route for 5m, rollback. Also keep circuit-breaker ready.
deploy-bot: Wave A (5%) started ts=1719759999. Pin api@2.7.0 for 45m.
dan: Pin command if ops needs it:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://infra.internal/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"svc":"api","ver":"2.7.0","ttl":"45m"}'
```
maria: Smoke report after 6m: no 5xx, cpu up ~15%, kv-hit stable. :+1:
kevin: Flipped runtime_header_swap=true at 22:36:10 UTC. Verified header present in responses.
infra-bot: Telemetry: p50 +12%, p95 +18%, p99 +55% in eu-west; memory headroom reduced to 20% in some hosts.
dan: Noting mem_headroom 20% on a subset; mem_guard at 0.85 should prevent OOM but tail latency may be impacted. Watch p99.
sasha: If rollback: unpin api, flip runtime_header_swap=false, set router override to stable, scale down reserved GPUs. Runbook in notes.
maria: Ramp to 20% starting 22:48 UTC.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 20% complete. Traffic now at 20%.
ops-bot: Alert: two mem alloc failure logs in eu-west-2 within 4m. Marking infra paged.
kevin: Observed increased tail and a few alloc_fail entries. Rolling back per OOM rule.
kevin: Executing rollback: runtime_header_swap=false (done). Routing override -> stable applied.
deploy-bot: Rolling back wave and unpinning api@2.7.0.
ops-bot: Releasing reserved GPUs at 22:58 UTC.
infra-bot: Hosts in eu-west recovered after restart; no further alloc_fail alerts.
sasha: Drafting incident note and postmortem. Tagging kernel, runtime, observability. Will include timeline and follow-ups.
maria: Action items: add a preflight kernel stress test for multi-tenant kv patterns, increase smoke duration for kernel changes, and keep pin TTLs conservative.
kevin: Agreed. Also schedule an interlock with router team to rehearse header swap rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Release aborted. Marking change window as cleared.
